_snapshotData.name: DexCom, Inc.
_snapshotData.description: DexCom, Inc., a medical device company, focuses on the design, development, and commercialization of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems for the management of diabetes and metabolic health in the United States and internationally. The company offers Dexcom G7 and G7 15 Day, an integrated continuous glucose monitoring system; Dexcom G6, a CGM system; Dexcom ONE+ to replace fingerstick blood glucose testing for diabetes treatment decisions; Stelo, a biosensor designed for adults with prediabetes and Type 2 diabetes who do not use insulin; Dexcom Share, a remote monitoring system; and Dexcom Follow application. It markets its products directly to endocrinologists, physicians, and diabetes educators. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in San Diego, California.

moatAnalysis.moat_narrative: DexCom, Inc. possesses a wide economic moat (score: 70/100). Strongest advantages: Supply-Side Economies (strong) and Learning Curve (strong). DexCom, Inc.

supply_side.explanation: DexCom, Inc. has strong supply-side economies of scale. Revenue growing at 13.1% with earnings growing at 43.6% — positive 30.5% operating leverage. strong gross margins of 62.5% and operating margins of 24.3% at at current scale.

network_effects.explanation: DexCom, Inc. has limited demand-side economies of scale. Medical Devices suggests limited network potential. Financial trends do not strongly indicate network effects. Awaiting user product-level assessment.

learning_curve.explanation: DexCom, Inc. has strong learning curve advantages. In Medical Devices, cumulative R&D creates knowledge barriers new entrants cannot replicate. Historical margin data confirms sustained high margins.

switching_costs.explanation: DexCom, Inc. benefits from strong switching costs. Medical Devices creates structural switching costs — medical devices require FDA-specific approvals tied to specific products. 62% gross margins suggest customers pay premium rather than switch. YoY revenue growth of 13.1% indicates strong customer retention.

aiDisruption.net_assessment: DexCom, Inc. faces a neutral from AI. AI creates both challenges and opportunities that roughly balance.
